events.summary: Windward data reported no outbound Hormuz transits in the prior 24 hours, four inbound vessels on Aug. 24, and overall traffic around 3% of prewar levels.
events.observed_fact: Argus reported Windward data showing zero outbound vessels over the prior 24 hours and four inbound vessels on Aug. 24: three using the northern lane and one tanker using the southern lane.
events.verified_effect: The source-specific tracking sample supports continued near-shutdown of visible commercial traffic despite the Iran-Oman corridor framework.
events.counterevidence: Different tracking providers and AIS visibility can produce different transit counts; this record does not claim zero total physical vessel movement.
events.continuity_evidence: Extends the Aug. 24 Atlas traffic record showing visible Hormuz traffic remained roughly 90% below pre-conflict baselines.

revision_history.change: Added as a late Aug. 25 append-only traffic update after the 21:14 ET overlay cutoff.
